# .NET Version Upgrade Progress

## Overview

Upgrading ObsTool solution from .NET Core 3.0 to .NET 10.0 LTS using an All-At-Once strategy. The solution consists of 2 SDK-style projects (1 ASP.NET Core application + 1 test project) with straightforward package updates and minor API breaking changes to fix.

**Progress**: 1/4 tasks complete (25%) ![25%](https://progress-bar.xyz/25)

## Tasks

- ✅ 01-update-project-files: Update target frameworks to net10.0
- 🔲 02-update-nuget-packages: Upgrade NuGet dependencies
- 🔲 03-fix-breaking-changes: Address API incompatibilities
- 🔲 04-verify-solution: Build and test validation
